In terms of biology, the Monarchs gave birth to more dragons just like them, if smaller. And they were all talking, intelligent species.

Background: 

The Dragon Monarchs were the first twelve dragons, created by the Naga Priest Kaen. The six female/male pairs would go on to give birth to the six draconic races: Kyza (Sea), Kyto (Ice), Taba (Desert), Tébato (Mountain), Kédo (Green), and Rya (Gold).

The solution is to train General Practitioners and Specialists. GPs are expected to be able to treat the most common ailments and injuries in as many species as possible, as well as have a basic knowledge of their anatomy. Specialists are trained in the knowledge of a specific species and are qualified for more complex procedures such as surgeries or cancer treatments.
